first_frame.observed: scene_s1.png (a frame near the start) shows a large, recognizable OpenEvidence AI tool unit with a card slot at the record edge. Board puts the question card entering the tool at 0.42 s and hook payoff at 1.2 s. Provider reports typing hands. I did not watch the video, only that still, so motion at the first frame is unverified by me.

visual_progression.observed: Board has eight scenes with three timed events each, progressing question to answer, dates, sign-in, citations, usage share, limits, accuracy gap, evaluation close. The scene_s6.png still confirms the Answer card with Sources filled and Accuracy dashed. Remaining progression is from board text and provider, not my viewing.

shot_variety.observed: Board assigns varied camera strategies (truckAcross, dollyThrough, craneDown, riseWith, orbitReveal) and distinct visual families per scene. The two stills I saw differ clearly (wall-mounted tool vs. close card on a lined desk). Cut-to-cut variety in the video itself was not inspected by me.

Timing is from board and captions; motion not viewed by me.
